Platform Engineer - Marlowe Freight Technologies

About us: Marlowe builds route-planning software for regional freight carriers.

You will:
- Maintain our CI/CD pipelines and internal developer platform
- Automate infrastructure with Terraform on AWS
- Work with product teams to improve deploy times

Requirements:
- 4+ years in a DevOps or platform role
- Terraform and AWS (ECS, RDS, IAM)
- Scripting in Python or Bash
- Fluent English

Nice to have:
- Experience with GitHub Actions
- Basic German

Senior level. Hybrid, Rotterdam office three days a week.
